clips.title: The story
paras: The Chest of Containment Coffers contains enchanted receptacles used by mages to capture unstable magical phenomena. It serves as essential equipment for practitioners sent to investigate and safely trap unseen mana anomalies.

Magical experimentation and sudden planar rifts frequently spawn volatile, invisible anomalies made entirely of arcane force. Standard physical cages cannot hold entities composed purely of magic. The Chest of Containment Coffers provides mages with specialized, enchanted coffers engineered to entrap and bind these subdued creatures alive. Kept near senior instructors such as Anastasia Hartwell in the Undercity and Jennea Cannon in Stormwind, the chest provides the necessary gear for initiates tasked with surveying anomalies before they can destabilize their surroundings.
